task.description: WF-03 Step 0.5: search docs/issues/*.yaml for a status: resolved entry whose description mentions matching symptoms (CORS, allow_headers, cors.ex) to ISS-0780 (missing x-bpm-user-id, and audited If-Match/Idempotency-Key, in Letflow.Plugs.Cors's @allow_headers).
acceptance_criteria: for each hit, determine whether it is the same symptom class (same root cause recurring) or a different CORS-adjacent issue
state in result.summary whether a prior match was found, and if so, whether this is a recurrence requiring a severity bump

result.summary: Searched docs/issues/*.yaml (case-insensitive grep on 'cors|allow_headers') -- 3 hits: ISS-0529, ISS-0729, and ISS-0780 itself. ISS-0729 is unrelated (DefinitionListPage main-thread-freeze issue; 'cors' only appears there inside an unrelated aside about FRONTEND-DEV's own test harness hitting 'a false negative from a CORS test-config issue' during investigation -- not a defect in lib/letflow/plugs/cors.ex). ISS-0529 (status: resolved, resolving_run WF03-ISS0530-20260908) IS the same module (lib/letflow/plugs/cors.ex, test/letflow/plugs/cors_test.exs) and same general CORS-allowlist-omission class, but a DIFFERENT root cause and a DIFFERENT list: ISS-0529 was about @default_origins (the ORIGIN allowlist) missing http://localhost:4173, causing the tenant-config bootstrap preflight to be silently rejected and the SPA to fall back to a hardcoded Keycloak authority. ISS-0780 is about @allow_headers (the request-HEADER allowlist) missing x-bpm-user-id (and, per this run's own audit below, If-Match and Idempotency-Key too) -- a distinct constant in the same file, guarding a distinct CORS preflight dimension (allowed request headers, not allowed origins). No prior docs/issues/ entry addresses @allow_headers's header set at all; ISS-0529's own regression tests (test/letflow/plugs/cors_test.exs) do not touch @allow_headers. CONCLUSION: no clear match / no recurrence -- this is a genuinely new defect, not a re-occurrence of ISS-0529's fixed root cause. Severity stays at the filed MINOR pending Step 1's own reproduction (see step-01 handoff); no severity bump warranted since there is no prior fix of this exact root cause that failed to hold.
